items.title: Spain to impose border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
items.description: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from neighbouring Morocco into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta.

items.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
items.description: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.

items.title: I was standing in front of my teacher when she was shot, Thai pupil says
items.description: The student says she feared never seeing her mother again after the attack killed five teachers.

items.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
items.description: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

items.title: Spanish police arrest 78 people in bust of 'one of largest' smuggling networks
items.description: The group moved synthetic drugs from Spain to Algeria, then used the return journey to smuggle migrants and weapons.

items.title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
items.description: Feliks the eagle was abducted as he first flew the nest in Serbia and wound up in the Middle East with poachers who demanded a ransom.

items.title: Mexico and Peru restore diplomatic relations after asylum row
items.description: Relations broke down after former Peruvian Prime Minister Betssy Chávez sought asylum in the Mexican embassy in November 2025.

items.title: Hunter Biden tells BBC his pardon was 'not good' for America or his father's legacy
items.description: In a wide-ranging BBC interview, the former president's son denied having any interest in running for office and spoke frankly on his father's declining health.

items.title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
items.description: The ruling is in addition to $375m in fines Meta was already ordered to pay in the case, for a total of $942m.

items.title: A new youth agitation grips an Indian state after 'cockroach' protests
items.description: Weeks after the CJP protests shook Delhi, a new youth-led movement over jobs and recruitment is gathering force in Jharkhand.

items.title: Trump administration to pay German firm $1.2bn to halt US wind projects
items.description: The RWE payout is the latest in a string of deals cancelling wind energy projects, a power source long derided by Trump.

items.title: Trump again tries to limit US birthright citizenship with new executive orders
items.description: The executive orders ban birth tourism and expand the existing definition of people whose children are not eligible for US birthright citizenship.
